operations.description: Search the workspace's messages that the user token can see for query, one page per call of at most count (1 to 100) results, page selecting which page; sort by score or timestamp, sort_dir asc or desc. Needs a user token with search:read, not a bot token. Slack's answer with ok false is refused, Slack's error named as the reason

List the conversations the user token can see, the private channels and direct messages that user is in included, one page per call of at most limit (1 to 1000); each later call sends the previous page's response_metadata.next_cursor as cursor, and the walk ends on a page whose next_cursor is empty. Needs the user scopes channels:read and groups:read, and im:read and mpim:read for those types. Slack's answer with ok false is refused, Slack's error named as the reason

Read the messages of one conversation the user can read, whether or not a bot is in it, newest first, one page per call, optionally within oldest and latest (Slack ts); each later call sends the previous page's response_metadata.next_cursor as cursor, and the walk ends on a page whose next_cursor is empty. Needs the user scope channels:history, groups:history, im:history or mpim:history for the conversation's type. Slack's answer with ok false is refused, Slack's error named as the reason

Read one thread of a conversation the user can read, the parent message identified by channel and ts followed by its replies, one page per call, optionally within oldest and latest (Slack ts); each later call sends the previous page's response_metadata.next_cursor as cursor, and the walk ends on a page whose next_cursor is empty. Needs the user scope channels:history, groups:history, im:history or mpim:history for the conversation's type. Slack's answer with ok false is refused, Slack's error named as the reason

List the workspace's users, one page per call; each later call sends the previous page's response_metadata.next_cursor as cursor, and the walk ends on a page whose next_cursor is empty. Send limit: without it Slack tries to answer the whole list at once. Needs the user scope users:read. Slack's answer with ok false is refused, Slack's error named as the reason
